newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatia says road building a strategic priority.
newsitem.headline: Croatia says road building a strategic priority.

text.p: Rebuilding of war damaged roads and construction of new transport links to better connect Croatia with main European routes is a top strategic interest, a senior government minister said on Monday.

Transport and Communications Minister Zeljko Luzavec told a news conference Croatia expects reopening of a West-East route from Slovenia through northern Croatia to Serbia to bring it considerable revenue in the future.
It used to be one of the most travelled roads by tourists and truckers to the south-eastern Europe workers before former Yugoslavia broke apart in 1991.
Croatia plans to complete a 40 km motorway stretch between capital Zagreb and Gorican on the Hungarian border before this summer's tourist season, Luzavec said.
It will also insist on a road between the port of Rijeka and Trieste in Italy to be included in the so-called "Corridor Five," connecting Trieste with Budapest and Kiev.
Rijeka is only 35 km from Trieste via Slovenia. It will soon be linked to Zagreb by a quick motorway, cutting travel from the northern Adriatic to just over two hours.
